name: Synapton
description: A proprietary SNT-binding agent that temporarily synchronizes the BCI handshake protocols of two or more users, creating a shared sensory loop between their augmented systems. Originally developed for military fire-team coordination, Synapton has found its way into recreational use — couples sharing tactile augment feeds, artists creating collaborative sensory installations, and fixers coordinating silent tactical operations. The shared state is partial, not telepathic: you feel what your partner's chrome feels, not their thoughts.
effects: Bidirectional sensory feed between linked users' augments
Shared proprioceptive awareness — each user knows the other's physical state
Tactical coordination enhanced dramatically — linked combatants fight as a unit
Recreational users report intimacy described as 'deeper than skin'
Augment inputs from both users processed simultaneously
side_effects: Sensory bleed — difficulty distinguishing your own body from your partner's
Emotional contagion through physical sensation (pain, pleasure, panic are shared)
Desync on separation causes 1-4 hours of dissociation
Rare cases of persistent phantom limb sensation from partner's augments post-session
Seizure risk if one partner's BCI is damaged or malfunctioning during link
cultural_context: Synapton is sold in pairs — you buy two doses and share them with your link partner. In Tier 3, it's a date-night drug, a way for augmented couples to experience each other through chrome. In Tier 2, combat crews use it for operations, and the emotional intimacy that builds in a Synapton-linked team creates bonds that are almost tribal. There are underground Synapton parlors where strangers link briefly — it's called 'ghosting' someone, and the culture around it is ambivalent: profound and exploitative in equal measure.
story_hooks: A Synapton-linked combat team was hit mid-operation — one member died while linked, and the survivor experienced the death from inside. They haven't been right since, and they're looking for the person who sent them into that ambush.
An underground Synapton parlor is being used to copy sensory data from linked users — someone is harvesting the augment feeds of wealthy Tier 3 clients for corporate intelligence

Two estranged former partners, both heavily augmented, are linked via Synapton against their will — someone has dosed them both and they have hours to find the source before permanent desync damage sets in
